description: This is a unit test class for the AboutOrganizationAPI, part of the OrangeHRM core API module. It tests the API's 'getOne' method and confirms that other methods like 'update', 'delete', and their validation rules are not implemented.

classes.name: AboutOrganizationAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the AboutOrganizationAPI endpoints, particularly the 'getOne' method, ensuring proper behavior and handling of not implemented methods.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests the 'getOne' method of the AboutOrganizationAPI, verifying it returns expected data based on test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases data from 'AboutOrganizationTestCase.yaml' for the 'testGetOne' method.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Ensures that calling 'update' on the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Checks that 'getValidationRuleForUpdate' method is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Verifies that calling 'delete' on the API throws a 'Not Implemented' exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Ensures 'getValidationRuleForDelete' method is not implemented and throws the expected exception.
